- Do we issue a credit memo that references INV-20261103, or create a proforma/offset?

- Any impact to deferred revenue for the PoC extension?

Attaching Helix's request. Hoping to get this closed this week so they can reconcile with AP.

Hi Lauren / team,

Finance review notes and recommended treatment below:

1) Accounting treatment: issue a formal credit memo referencing INV-20261103 and classify it as contra-revenue. We should map to GLA 7050 (Sales Discounts & Allowances). This aligns with prior promo credits and keeps P&L impact transparent as reduced revenue rather than an operating expense.

2) Journal entry: create a credit memo in the billing system and post a reversing journal entry to contra-revenue. If HelixBio requires a standalone proforma for AP reconciliation, we can also generate a proforma copy that mirrors the credit memo but final posting should be the credit memo.

3) Deferred revenue: the one-month extension for a PoC with no additional invoiced consideration does not require reclassifying deferred revenue. If we end up invoicing for the extended month later, we'll review then.

4) Approvals & audit trail: please include the HubSpot deal id (DEAL-78104) and attach the customer's approval form to the credit memo. We also need internal approval from Sales Ops (Marissa) and Revenue Ops (Lauren) before posting.

5) Timeline: we can draft the credit memo and provide a PDF stub to HelixBio by end of day Thursday (11/12) if approvals are returned by EOD Wednesday.

I've attached our internal workflow checklist for credits. Let me know if you want me to draft the memo.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Accounting Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Ellen — thanks for the patience.

Quick update and next steps:

- We've approved a $15,000 promotional credit to be applied to INV-20261103. Finance will issue a formal credit memo (reference CM-20261115-Helix) that applies against the invoice. The memo will be classified as contra-revenue (GLA 7050) per our accounting guidance.
- You should see the credit reflected on your next statement; we'll also send a PDF of the credit memo to your billing contact once posted.
- We've extended the PoC access for one month; the new trial end date is 2027-01-07 for the additional seats you requested. There is no additional invoicing for the extension.

Action items for you: please confirm the invoice number to which we'd apply the credit (we have INV-20261103 on file) and confirm the AP contact to receive the PDF (billing@helixbio.com listed).

Action items for us: Neha will draft and post the credit memo after we receive your confirmation; Marissa and I will add the HubSpot note (DEAL-78104) and attach the signed request form for audit.

Thanks — we'll send the credit memo PDF once posted.
